0.long_answer: Cromolyn sodium, also known as sodium cromoglycate, was discovered in 1965 by Roger Altounyan. This medication acts as a mast cell stabilizer by preventing the release of inflammatory mediators such as histamine and leukotrienes. It is commonly used in the treatment of allergic conditions, including allergic conjunctivitis, as well as in the management of asthma and other allergic responses.
